authority: diagnostic: paper only, not investment advice
flags: The Audit Committee dismissed Grant Thornton as independent auditor and engaged KPMG for the fiscal year ending June 30, 2027. Grant Thornton's reports were not adverse or qualified, and the company reports no disagreements.

The company signed a Second Amended and Restated Credit Agreement. It converts the facility to an uncommitted revolving line payable on demand, cuts it from $427,500,000 to $250,000,000, and removes a number of caps and covenants.

CFO Cary Dickson submitted his resignation, effective September 18, 2026. Controller Jill Van became Chief Financial Officer on that date, and the press release describes his exit as a planned retirement.

interest_from_filing.why: The tagged InterestExpense appears to be total interest expense, which per the MD&A covers lines of credit, notes payable, product financing arrangements, and borrowed-metals/precious-metals leases, so dividing it by the small notes-payable balance gives a meaningless ratio, and the fiscal 2026 evidence shown does not break out interest on borrowings alone.

no_value_reason: implied borrowing cost outside the allowed range

business_model.claim: The company sells precious metals (gold, silver, platinum, palladium) and collectibles such as rare coins and currency. It describes itself as a vertically integrated platform spanning trading, logistics, financing and minting.
quotes: Founded in 1965, Gold.com offers comprehensive solutions for all aspects of the precious metals (gold, silver, platinum, and palladium) and collectibles (including rare coins and currency) value chains.

business_model.basis: stated in the 10-K and 10-Q MD&A; link to the acquisition is inferred from both
business_model.claim: Reporting segments changed. The fiscal 2026 10-K described three segments (Wholesale Sales & Ancillary Services, Direct-to-Consumer, Secured Lending). The September 2026 10-Q describes four, adding Minting & Refining.
quotes: We conduct our operations through three complementary segments: Wholesale Sales & Ancillary Services, Direct-to-Consumer, and Secured Lending.
We conduct our operations through four complementary segments: Wholesale Sales & Ancillary Services, Direct-to-Consumer, Minting & Refining, and Secured Lending.

business_model.claim: Wholesale Sales & Ancillary Services sells metals to industrial and commercial users, coin and bullion dealers, mints and financial institutions. It also earns from ancillary services such as financing, storage, consignment and logistics.
quotes: The Company enters into transactions to sell and deliver gold, silver, platinum, and palladium to industrial and commercial users, coin and bullion dealers, mints, and financial institutions.
We offer our customers a variety of ancillary services, including financing, storage, consignment, logistics, and various customized financial programs.

business_model.basis: stated in the 10-K MD&A and the earnings release
business_model.claim: Direct-to-Consumer sells metals and coins to retail customers online, by phone and through marketing channels. Brands include JM Bullion, Goldline, Stack's Bowers, Pinehurst and, since January 2026, Monex. It supplied 70% of consolidated gross profit in the latest quarter (71% a year earlier).
quotes: JMB is a leading e-commerce retailer providing access to a broad array of gold, silver, copper, platinum, and palladium products through its websites.
The Direct-to-Consumer segment contributed 70% and 71% of the consolidated gross profit in the fiscal first quarters of 2027 and 2026, respectively.

business_model.basis: stated in the earnings release metrics table
business_model.claim: The direct-to-consumer customer base is large and growing. Total customers were 4,818,400, active customers were 148,600 and new customers were 96,100 in the September 2026 quarter. Average order value was $3,482.
quotes: Direct-to-Consumer new customers for the three months ended September 30, 2026 increased 38% to 96,100 from 69,400 for the three months ended September 30, 2025

business_model.basis: stated in the 10-K MD&A and the earnings release
business_model.claim: Secured Lending, run through CFC, makes commercial loans secured mainly by bullion and numismatic coins to dealers, investors and collectors. At September 30, 2026 it held 372 loans and $107,415,000 of secured loans receivable.
quotes: CFC is a California licensed finance lender that originates and acquires commercial loans secured primarily by bullion and numismatic coins.

business_model.basis: stated in the income statement, MD&A and earnings release
business_model.claim: This is a high-volume, thin-margin business. In the September 2026 quarter, revenues of 3,265,269 less cost of sales of 3,175,652 left gross profit of 89,617 (table in thousands), a gross margin of 2.74% against 1.98% a year earlier.
quotes: The Company operates in a high volume/low margin industry.
Gross profit margin for the three months ended September 30, 2026 increased to 2.74% of revenue

business_model.basis: stated in the 10-Q MD&A and the earnings release
business_model.claim: Reported revenue is driven by product volume, metal prices and market volatility. Forward sales used for hedging can swing revenue with little effect on margin. In the latest quarter revenue fell 11% to $3.265 billion, but excluding a $1.368 billion decrease in forward sales it rose $0.953 billion, or 51%.
quotes: Revenues are impacted by three primary factors: product volume, market prices, and market volatility.
Since the volume of hedging can be significant, the movement in and out of forwards can substantially impact revenues, either positively or negatively, from period to period.

Excluding a decrease of $1.368 billion of forward sales, our revenues increased $0.953 billion, or 51%, which was due to higher average selling prices of gold and silver as well as an increase in gold and silver ounces sold.

business_model.basis: stated in the 10-Q MD&A; the counter-risk is stated in the 10-K risk factor summary
business_model.claim: Hedging largely insulates gross profit from metal price moves. Derivative gains and losses are intended to offset changes in inventory value, so results are generally not materially affected by commodity prices.
quotes: However, the gains and losses on the derivative instruments are substantially offset by the gains and losses on the corresponding changes in the market value of our precious metals inventory.

business_model.basis: stated in the earnings release; the expense line also appears in the income statement
business_model.claim: Operating costs are mainly selling, general and administrative expense, which rose 19% to $71.2 million in the latest quarter. The main causes were higher compensation ($6.7 million) and advertising ($2.4 million) costs, plus the newly acquired Monex and SMI.
quotes: an increase in compensation expense of $6.7 million, higher advertising costs of $2.4 million

business_model.basis: stated in the earnings release and 10-K MD&A
business_model.claim: Financing cost is a key cost driver. The company funds inventory with its Trading Credit Facility, precious metals leases and product financing. Interest expense was $12.5 million in the latest quarter, with lower credit-facility interest offset by higher metals-lease interest.
quotes: an increase of $6.2 million related to precious metals leases driven by higher overall borrowings

business_model.basis: stated in the 10-K risk factors and the 10-Q MD&A
business_model.claim: Tether is a related party and now the main liquidity source, through precious metals leases, and also a large customer. It accounted for 25.3% of first-quarter fiscal 2027 revenues, and the company warns that a decline in that trading activity could hurt results.
quotes: While our liquidity in recent months has been provided primarily by precious metals leases, a majority of which are from Tether, prior to this, our liquidity was generally provided by our Trading Credit Facility.
During the first fiscal quarter of 2027, 25.3% of our revenues were generated from sales to Tether.

business_model.claim: Bank financing was restructured on September 29, 2026. The credit facility became uncommitted and payable on demand, and was cut in size, while several caps and covenants were removed. This matters because the business depends on financing.
quotes: converts the Existing Credit Agreement into an uncommitted revolving line of credit which is payable on demand
reduces the facility from $427,500,000 to $250,000,000

business_model.basis: stated in the balance sheet and cash flow statement; the link to Tether is not stated
business_model.claim: Customer advances swing the balance sheet and operating cash flow. Deferred revenue and other advances fell from 2,139,974 to 1,439,499 (table in thousands), a (700,475) cash-flow item that drove operating cash flow of (638,584). A related-party amount of $689,231 is disclosed in the cash-flow caption.
Growth relies partly on acquisitions. The latest quarter's revenue and gross profit gains included the acquisitions of Monex and SMI, which were not in the year-ago period.
quotes: Revenues also increased due to the acquisitions of Monex in January 2026 and SMI in April 2026.

We conduct our operations through four complementary segments: Wholesale Sales & Ancillary Services, Direct-to-Consumer, Minting & Refining, and Secured Lending.

quotes: The Company operates in a high volume/low margin industry.

quotes: increased to 2.74% of revenue, from 1.98% of revenue

competitive_position.basis: Stated in the earnings release; the Monex effect is the company's attribution.

quotes: The increase in new customers from the same year-ago quarter was primarily due to the acquisition of Monex in January 2026, as well as JMB’s activity

competitive_position.basis: Stated in the earnings release; the higher-margin mechanism is inferred.

quotes: The Direct-to-Consumer segment contributed 70% and 71% of the consolidated gross profit in the fiscal first quarters of 2027 and 2026, respectively.

competitive_position.basis: Stated by the company in the cited items.

quotes: After decades of collaboration, in January 2026, we acquired Monex, one of the largest and most established direct-to-consumer precious metals dealers in the US.
has meaningfully expanded our production capabilities

competitive_position.basis: Stated in the 10-Q MD&A and the 10-K risk factors.
competitive_position.claim: Tether is both a major customer and a financing and equity partner. 25.3% of first-quarter revenue came from sales to Tether, and the company warns a decline in that activity could hurt results. This is a concentration threat.
quotes: During the first fiscal quarter of 2027, 25.3% of our revenues were generated from sales to Tether.
The Company has entered into various commercial agreements with Tether whereby the Company leases precious metals from Tether, and Tether purchases and sells precious metals with the Company.

quotes: Our business depends substantially on our ability to obtain financing for our operations.

competitive_position.basis: Stated in the 8-K; the withdrawal risk is inferred from the 'uncommitted' and 'payable on demand' terms.

competitive_position.basis: Stated in the balance sheet and cash flow statement; the link to competitive position is inferred.

Retail competition and search-engine dependence are named threats. The direct-to-consumer segment faces intense competition. JMB's SEO advantage may shrink as rivals improve their own SEO.
quotes: Our Direct-to-Consumer segment is subject to intense competition from other online retailers, traditional coin stores and general online merchandisers.
JMB’s search engine optimization (SEO) has provided it with a competitive advantage, but its competitors are improving their own SEO strategies which may reduce JMB’s advantage.

competitive_position.basis: Stated in the 10-K MD&A and risk factors.

Our Wholesale Sales & Ancillary Services segment is dependent on our relationships with government mints.
Our Wholesale Sales & Ancillary Services segment is at times dependent on a concentrated customer base.

competitive_position.basis: Stated in the earnings release; Monex and SMI volumes are included only from their acquisition dates.

quotes: with more gold and silver ounces sold and a larger customer base
Activity moderated from the exceptional levels we saw earlier this year

competitive_position.claim: Reported revenue fell 11% to $3.265 billion. The company attributes this to lower forward sales used for hedging: excluding a $1.368 billion decrease in forward sales, revenue rose 51%. Revenue is therefore a poor read on competitive strength.

competitive_position.basis: Stated in the earnings release and the 10-K risk factors.

competitive_position.claim: Demand depends on investor sentiment and world events, which the company cannot control. The 10-K says its business is likely to be influenced by world events more than other sectors. It also names tariffs and China-related tensions as risks.
quotes: Because our business is dependent on the volatility and pricing of precious metals, we are likely to be influenced by world events more than businesses in other economic sectors.

Tariffs that have recently been imposed or threatened may result in higher costs, reduce our margins, and if retaliatory tariffs were imposed in foreign jurisdictions, demand for our products in those jurisdictions may decline.

competitive_position.claim: The business relies on key management. The 10-K names the CEO as a dependency, and the CFO changed in September 2026 when the controller succeeded the retiring CFO.
quotes: We are dependent on key management, particularly our CEO, Mr. Gregory Roberts.
